about.title: About Us
about.body: We deliver Japanese anime and IP news to fans around the world, fast and accurately, in their own language. Beyond news, we host fan communities for every series and a weekly prize for the best fan posts. Consistent, official-first terminology is the core of our reliability.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: News tips, partnership inquiries, press release submissions and takedown requests (DMCA equivalent) are welcome. We will get back to you as soon as possible.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body: We respect your privacy. We collect and use data only to the minimum extent necessary to provide our services, and we do not share your personal data with third parties. This policy will be updated as our services evolve.
